tools.name: search_archive
tools.description: Search the ISHOB archive (titles, keywords, authors). All words must match. Free.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List knowledge topics with live resource counts. Free.

tools.name: get_catalog_page
tools.description: Browse the catalog, 100 resources per page, optionally by topic. Free.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Record metadata, abstract, license and attribution for one resource. Paid ($0.001, x402).

tools.name: get_fulltext
tools.description: Structured full text (sections) of one resource, with license. Paid ($0.01, x402).

tools.name: get_references
tools.description: Parsed reference list of one resource. Paid ($0.002, x402).

tools.name: extract_webpage
tools.description: Fetch a public web page live (robots.txt respected) and return clean Markdown. Not stored or redistributed. Paid ($0.0005, x402).

tools.name: search_specs
tools.description: Full-text search over abstracts and full texts, with extracted technical specifications (values, ranges, tolerances, units). Numeric constraints like "50 Nm" are matched. Paid ($0.001, x402).

tools.name: query_specs
tools.description: Structured specification table filtered by quantity (e.g. accuracy, wavelength, range), unit family, unit and value range, with source document and license. Paid ($0.001, x402).
